text: Build encapsulated components that manage their own state and compose into complex UIs
quote: Build encapsulated components that manage their own state, then compose them to make complex UIs.

text: Add React to an existing HTML page and render interactive components without a full rewrite
quote: You don’t have to build your whole page in React. Add React to your existing HTML page, and render interactive React components anywhere on it.

text: Write markup and rendering logic together using JSX syntax
quote: This markup syntax is called JSX. It is a JavaScript syntax extension popularized by React.

text: Pass new data into components in response to interactions and React updates the screen to match
quote: You can pass them new data in response to an interaction, like when the user types into an input. React will then update the screen to match the new data.

text: Use an official full-stack meta-framework (Next.js/React Router) for building complete apps
quote: To build an entire app with React, we recommend a full-stack React framework like Next.js or React Router.

text: Build native mobile apps for Android and iOS using React Native/Expo with truly native UIs
quote: React Native and Expo let you build apps in React for Android, iOS, and more. They look and feel native because their UIs are truly native.

text: Stream HTML from the server while still fetching data, progressively filling in content before JS loads
quote: On the server, React lets you start streaming HTML while you’re still fetching data, progressively filling in the remaining content before any JavaScript code loads.

text: Use as little or as much React as needed, scaling from a widget to a full app
quote: you can use as little or as much React as you need

text: Frameworks built on React can fetch data in asynchronous server or build-time components
quote: Frameworks that implement it let you fetch data in asynchronous components that run on the server or even during the build.
